name: FEA-Bench
intro: FEA-Bench评估大模型在代码仓库中增量实现新功能的能力。论文从Top PyPI的8,000个包出发，经许可证、PR数量与快速pytest验证确定119个来源仓，再通过新组件比例、GPT-4o意图和金标准补丁后测试全过等门禁，得到83个仓库的1,401个任务；Lite子集含48个仓库的200题。
build_method: Top PyPI仓库筛选, PR测试变更抓取, 新组件规则过滤, GPT-4o意图分类, 补丁前后pytest验证
metric: Resolved Ratio, Patch Apply Rate, Retrieval Precision/Recall
task_type: 代码生成, 代码编辑, 代码补全
task_type_en: Code Generation, Code Editing, Code Completion
build_method_en: Top PyPI Repository Screening, Test-changing PR Collection, New-component Rule Filtering, GPT-4o Intent Classification, Before/after-patch pytest Validation
intro_en: FEA-Bench evaluates repository-level incremental feature implementation. The paper starts from 8,000 Top PyPI packages, identifies 119 source repositories through license, pull-request-count, and fast pytest validation, then applies new-component-ratio, GPT-4o intent, and post-gold-patch all-tests-pass gates to obtain 1,401 tasks from 83 repositories; the Lite subset contains 200 tasks from 48 repositories.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.06680v2 §3.1-§3.3, §4.2, Appendix A.2, Appendix A.3, and Appendix B.1, plus official repository snapshot fb3c112. The source gate starts from 8,000 Top PyPI packages, keeps roughly 600 licensed repositories with over 1,000 PRs, and validates the first 20 test-changing PRs to retain 18 SWE-bench plus 101 other repositories. Merged test-changing PRs must add Python functions/classes covering over 25% of edited lines, be classified as new-feature intent by GPT-4o, fit 8,192 tokens, and pass the executable before/after protocol; before gold, tests may pass or fail and ImportError/AttributeError are allowed, while after gold there can be no FAILED status. Full has 1,401 tasks/83 repositories and Lite has 200/48, but Lite is rule-filtered rather than professionally human-verified; Appendix A.3 proposes a future verified subset. Due to licensing/company policy, the full dataset is not released: Hugging Face provides essential attributes and remaining fields must be reconstructed from GitHub.
